meta.title: Improve mmaitag memory handling
meta.body_summary: Fix memory management in the mmaitag plugin by allocating provider instances per action and guarding message duplication/JSON creation with CHKmalloc.

perf_labels.notes: Small C memory-safety fix merged without addressing bot review feedback; no benchmark; confidence high.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 42 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a minimal memory-safety performance fix and is consistent with the quick merge by the maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot reviewer flagged missing NULL check for 'name' parameter in get_provider, which could lead to a segmentation fault; also suggested using strndup for simpler allocation.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve memory handling and safety in mmaitag plugin via per-action provider allocation and CHKmalloc guards.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level C memory management fix within a single plugin file is within agent capability, but bot review caught potential NULL dereference that agent missed; merge not blocked.

detection_detail.code_reading: gemini-code-assist bot performed static analysis, identifying missing NULL check and suggesting strndup.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics; body lists compile/test steps but no performance measurement; bot review focused on code correctness.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression introduced; fix merged without addressing bot suggestions.

core_change_summary.description: In plugins/mmaitag/mmaitag.c, replaced placeholder provider lookup with per-action calloc/memcpy to provide private per-instance state, freed provider instances on destruction, and added CHKmalloc guards for message duplication and JSON object creation.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'fix mmaitag provider handling and memory safety' modified the plugin with memory management refactor and allocation checks.

review_signals.summary: Generated PR summary highlighting memory management improvements.
Identified missing NULL check for 'name' parameter in get_provider, recommending guard to prevent segfault.
review_signals.action_taken: No action taken; PR merged as-is.

review_signals.summary: Suggested using strndup instead of manual malloc+memcpy+null termination for message duplication.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by maintainer with agent-authored commit; bot reviews appear within minutes, providing summary and code review with two suggestions.
No human review; maintainer force-pushes (likely rebase) and merges after ~26.6 hours without addressing bot feedback.
